# Garden Race — Rulebook

The rules, written like a real rulebook: the single truth the game, the tests and the tutorial follow. A first pass is rough on purpose. BMUZ writes between its marks (<!-- bmuz … -->); anything you write outside them is yours and is always kept, and if you change BMUZ's text, your version is kept too.

## Overview

<!-- bmuz rb:overview · 8c1f1676 -->
Two friends race to grow the best garden.
<!-- /bmuz rb:overview -->

## Components

<!-- bmuz rb:components · 351cfad8 -->
- Seed cards: Sunflower ×6, Rose ×4
- Weather cards: Rain ×3, Hail ×3
- Each player: three rows
<!-- /bmuz rb:components -->

## How to Win

<!-- bmuz rb:win · 038b7d2f -->
When the seed deck runs out, finish the round; the most blooms wins.
<!-- /bmuz rb:win -->

## Setup

<!-- bmuz rb:setup · 61776c8c -->
Shuffle the seed and weather cards together; deal three cards each; each player has three empty rows.
<!-- /bmuz rb:setup -->

## Gameplay

### The Flow
<!-- bmuz rb:flow · cf63dcdf -->
1. Draw two cards.
2. Play one card: plant a seed in one of your rows, or send weather to one of your friend's rows.
3. Any row with three blooms scores and is cleared.
4. Your friend's turn.
<!-- /bmuz rb:flow -->

### Plant
<!-- bmuz rb:action-plant · abbf60ce -->
Put a seed card in one of your rows. A Sunflower blooms in 1 turn; a Rose in 2 turns and scores double.
<!-- /bmuz rb:action-plant -->

### Send weather
<!-- bmuz rb:action-send-weather · 64d5b622 -->
Rain makes a seed in that row bloom a turn sooner. Rule A / Rule B, to test: hail destroys one bloom (A) or the whole row (B).
<!-- /bmuz rb:action-send-weather -->

## Game End

<!-- bmuz rb:end · e241567b -->
The seed deck runs out: finish the round.
<!-- /bmuz rb:end -->

## Scoring

<!-- bmuz rb:scoring · ae0b60e7 -->
A row scores when it has three blooms: one point per bloom, a Rose two.
<!-- /bmuz rb:scoring -->

## Keywords

<!-- bmuz rb:keywords · 1b475d94 -->
- **Bloom**: a seed that has grown
- **Row**: one of your three planting lines
<!-- /bmuz rb:keywords -->
